Primary Care Progress Note
Date: 08/24/2026
Patient: Janyce Wintheiser, 71 y/o F

CC: Back pain

HPI: Back pain since 08/21/2026 after lifting a laundry basket. No radiation, numbness, or weakness reported. No prior similar episodes noted.

PE: Tenderness over lumbar paraspinal muscles. No step-offs or deformities palpated. ROM limited due to pain.

Assessment: Acute mechanical back pain.

Plan: Advise rest, NSAIDs as needed, and gradual return to activity. Follow-up in 2 weeks or sooner if symptoms worsen.

notes.title: Radiology Report
notes.author: Radiologist
notes.text:
Radiology Report
Date: 09/13/2026
Patient: Janyce Wintheiser, 71-year-old female

MRI 09/13/2026: T11 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR. Interval increase in T11 vertebral body height loss compared with radiographs from 08/25/2026. ~46% T11 height loss. No other acute abnormalities identified. Adjacent vertebral bodies are unremarkable. No evidence of paraspinal soft tissue mass or abnormal enhancement. Findings consistent with subacute compression fracture at T11.

notes.title: Spine Intervention Consultation
notes.author: Interventional radiologist
notes.text:
Spine Intervention Consultation
Date: 09/24/2026
Patient: Janyce Wintheiser, 71-year-old female

Outpt, not admitted. Pain at fx level; afebrile, no infx signs. NRS 6/10 despite 4 wks NSM (oxycodone 5 mg as needed, TLSO brace). Pain stable/slightly better. Physical exam reveals localized tenderness without neurological deficits. Imaging consistent with known vertebral compression fracture.

Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program. Continue current management and reassess for possible intervention if symptoms persist.
